$comment: The labeller's only input: a seeded draw of distinct findings, up to perRule of each rule, in a shuffled order. Each gives where the finding is (repository, pinned commit, file, line, column), its rule, its message exactly as onsystem printed it, the matched source text, and up to 15 lines of code from the pinned checkout, 7 above and 7 below the reported line, which is marked >. No suggested fix, no severity and no label. run, occurrence and fingerprint are the corpus keys (scripts/corpus-lib.ts).
